scientific_review.review_scope: Completed Poisson experiment: full raw-host audits, independent compact-field numerical recomputation, unrounded table rankings, paired-interval interpretation, and actual standalone figure inspection. Final manuscript integration and compiled-page review remain separate tasks.
accepted_findings: All four mean errors strictly decrease at the tested K values; all 16 Bonferroni-adjusted paired intervals against K=1 lie below zero.
K=10 captures 81.4-86.8% of the mean-error decrease observed at K=1000, with median within-input latency ratios of 1.86-1.89 against K=1.
K=100 to K=1000 lowers mean errors by only 0.0605-0.0933 percentage points at nearly ten times measured latency.
interpretation_limits: No claim of monotonic improvement for each physical input.
No significance claim for adjacent larger K values; adjusted comparisons are all against K=1.
The serial curve is a derived K-times-single reference, not a separate timed serial experiment.
This is fixed-model Poisson evidence under the stated observation, guidance, precision, and hardware settings.
These averaged-estimate latencies differ in scope from the FM4PDE-DiffusionPDE controlled timing study.
